This lends weight to the idea that traditional energies are still relevant and concomitant with energy transition, especially in a small open resource-oriented economy like Chile. In addition to that, bitcoin shocks seem to have contributed to Chile’s transition, likely as a result of bitcoin’s extensive use of energy and its potential to increase renewable energy capacity. Policywise, our findings call for a watchful eye on regulatory constraints, excessively high royalties, and the maintenance of stabilization funds to mitigate uncertainty, all of which can affect Chile’s competitive edge at an untimely hour.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了智利能源转型金属溢出效应的影响。研究旨在识别这些能源转型金属与石油、黄金和比特币等其他主要资产之间的因果关系，以及它们如何塑造智利的经济，无论是在COVID-19之前还是在大流行的最初几个月。我们的结构向量自回归分析使用了两个独立时期的日度频率数据，即COVID-19前分析（2018年全年）和COVID-19分析（2020年二月至2020年底）。我们的结果表明，智利在COVID-19期间对可再生能源冲击反应高度敏感，同时对传统石油驱动的冲击反应也有所增强。这支持了传统能源仍然相关且与能源转型并行的观点，尤其是在像智利这样的小型开放资源导向型经济体中。此外，比特币冲击似乎对智利的转型有所贡献，这可能是由于比特币对能源的广泛使用及其增加可再生能源产能的潜力。在政策方面，我们的发现呼吁关注监管限制、过高的特许权使用费以及维持稳定基金以缓解不确定性，所有这些都可能在不合时宜的时刻影响智利的竞争优势。

articles.title_en: Pricing behavior of clean energy stocks? Some trading implications
articles.title_cn: 清洁能源股票的定价行为？一些交易启示
articles.abstract_en: Mispricing and price adjustment to shocks are common features of stocks, which arise due to various types of shocks. Understanding mispricing and price adjustment mechanism can guide trading strategy design. Our hypothesis is that clean energy stocks are characterised by mispricing and that there are unique stocks in the sense that they move first when exposed to shocks. We employ a price discovery model to rank clean energy stock indices in terms of those that adjust to prices faster than those that do not. We then identify mispricing in those stocks using a market risk factor model. Utilizing time-series data on 11 clean energy stock indices, we propose eight trading strategies, and show that they offer annualized returns in the −5.37% to 61.10% range. Six of the eight strategies offer profits close to 15% or more, beating the buy and hold strategy. Trading strategies devised on mispricing suggest that two of the clean energy stocks can potentially beat the buy-and-hold strategy, offering annualized returns in excess of 13%. Because our results guide investors towards making profits from trading clean energy stocks, the implication is that the trading strategies can enhance the green finance market.
articles.abstract_cn: 错误定价和对冲击的价格调整是股票的常见特征，这些特征源于各种类型的冲击。理解错误定价和价格调整机制可以指导交易策略的设计。我们的假设是，清洁能源股票具有错误定价的特征，并且存在一些独特的股票，它们在受到冲击时首先移动。我们采用价格发现模型对清洁能源股票指数进行排序，以区分那些调整价格速度较快和较慢的指数。然后，我们使用市场风险因子模型识别这些股票中的错误定价。利用11个清洁能源股票指数的时间序列数据，我们提出了八种交易策略，并表明它们提供的年化收益率在−5.37%至61.10%之间。八种策略中有六种提供的利润接近15%或更高，超过了买入并持有策略。基于错误定价设计的交易策略表明，其中两种清洁能源股票有可能超越买入并持有策略，提供超过13%的年化收益率。由于我们的结果引导投资者从清洁能源股票交易中获利，这意味着这些交易策略可以促进绿色金融市场的发展。

articles.title_en: Global, Arctic, and Antarctic sea ice volume predictions using score-driven threshold climate models
articles.title_cn: 使用得分驱动阈值气候模型预测全球、北极和南极海冰体积
articles.abstract_en: The literature on sea ice predictions uses a variety of general circulation models (GCMs), which suggest diverse predictions of the date of ice-free or almost ice-free oceans, and focus mainly on the Arctic. GCMs are not sensitive enough to tipping points in the Atlantic meridional overturning circulation (AMOC), and they underestimate the sensitivity of Arctic sea ice to carbon emissions. We contribute to the literature in two ways: First, we use a novel time series model, named the score-driven threshold climate (SDTC) model, and we report global, Arctic, and Antarctic sea ice predictions. For the SDTC model, the estimations are computationally less demanding than those of the GCMs. Second, we combine long-run 1,000-year frequency climate data from 798,000 to 1,000 years ago, and short-run annual data from year 850 to year 2014. We present the evolution of long-run and short-run climate data with descriptive statistics. We estimate the SDTC model using annual data from 850 to 2014 for Arctic and Antarctic sea ice volume Icet and Antarctic land surface temperature Tempt. We use the atmospheric CO2,t concentration as a clustering variable to define periods of climate change. Hence, CO2,t concentration drives the regime-switching dynamics of parameters in the SDTC model. We report in-sample interval forecasts of global, Arctic, and Antarctic sea ice from 1980 to 2014. Observed global and Arctic sea ice volumes are below the forecasted interval from 2003. The observed Antarctic sea ice volume is below the forecasted interval from 2011. We report out-of-sample interval forecasts of sea ice from 2015 to 2314. The out-of-sample forecasts, μ[μ±2σ], indicate that if the current trend of climate change continues, then Arctic sea ice will disappear around 2058[2049,2068], and global and Antarctic sea ice will disappear around 2174[2123,2270].
articles.abstract_cn: 关于海冰预测的文献使用了各种环流模型（GCMs），这些模型对无冰或几乎无冰海洋日期的预测各不相同，且主要关注北极。GCMs对北大西洋经向翻转环流（AMOC）的临界点不够敏感，并且低估了北极海冰对碳排放的敏感性。我们通过两种方式为文献做出贡献：第一，我们使用一种新颖的时间序列模型，称为得分驱动阈值气候（SDTC）模型，并报告全球、北极和南极的海冰预测。对于SDTC模型，估计的计算需求低于GCMs。第二，我们结合了从798,000年前到1,000年前的长周期1,000年频率气候数据，以及从公元850年到2014年的短周期年度数据。我们用描述性统计呈现长周期和短周期气候数据的演变。我们使用公元850年至2014年的年度数据估计SDTC模型，针对北极和南极海冰体积Icet和南极地表温度Tempt。我们使用大气CO2,t浓度作为聚类变量来定义气候变化时期。因此，CO2,t浓度驱动SDTC模型中参数的机制转换动态。我们报告了1980年至2014年全球、北极和南极海冰的样本内区间预测。从2003年起，观测到的全球和北极海冰体积低于预测区间。从2011年起，观测到的南极海冰体积低于预测区间。我们报告了2015年至2314年海冰的样本外区间预测。样本外预测，μ[μ±2σ]，表明如果当前气候变化趋势持续，北极海冰将在2058年[2049, 2068]左右消失，全球和南极海冰将在2174年[2123, 2270]左右消失。

articles.title_en: Digital transformation by firms and the cleanliness of China's export products
articles.title_cn: 企业数字化转型与中国出口产品清洁度
articles.abstract_en: This study breaks the research chain on “firm digital transformation-trade green transformation”, focusing on the effect and mechanism in firms' digital transformation on the “cleanliness” of export products. It offers theoretical and empirical support on how to respond to demand for a green transformation in trade by firms in the context of their digital transformation. First, we reveal the mechanism in the effect of firms' digital transformation on export product cleanliness at the theoretical level by extending the Stackelberg game model and constructing a variable for product cleanliness. Second, we build an index to evaluate firms' digital transformation by matching data on A-share listed companies from 2007 to 2016 with a China Customs firm database and quantitatively analyze it with a machine learning algorithm. Combined with the measured export product cleanliness index, this mechanism is empirically tested with standardized measurement methods. Overall, we find that firms' digital transformation can significantly contribute to improvement in export product cleanliness. This finding remains robust to a series of tests and decomposition of digital transformation into various dimensions. The mechanism test found that the digital transformation of firms mainly promotes the improvement of export product cleanliness through the channels of increasing digital factor inputs, promoting green technology innovation, improving environmental management performance and achieving economies of scale. Heterogeneity analysis shows that digital transformation better facilitates the promotion of cleaner exported products from firms certified with ISO14001, whose primary export destinations are countries outside of the EU, and with high disclosure quality. Furthermore, digital transformation has a structural effect on the improvement of export product cleanliness in the context of urban disclosure of environmental information.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究打破了“企业数字化转型-贸易绿色转型”的研究链条，聚焦于企业数字化转型对出口产品“清洁度”的影响及机制，为企业如何在数字化转型背景下应对贸易绿色转型需求提供了理论和实证支持。首先，我们通过扩展Stackelberg博弈模型并构建产品清洁度变量，在理论层面揭示了企业数字化转型对出口产品清洁度的影响机制。其次，我们通过匹配2007年至2016年A股上市公司数据与中国海关企业数据库，构建了评估企业数字化转型的指标，并使用机器学习算法进行定量分析。结合测得的出口产品清洁度指数，我们采用标准化测量方法对该机制进行了实证检验。总体而言，我们发现企业数字化转型能够显著促进出口产品清洁度的提升。这一发现在一系列检验和将数字化转型分解为不同维度的分析中依然稳健。机制检验发现，企业数字化转型主要通过增加数字要素投入、促进绿色技术创新、改善环境管理绩效和实现规模经济等渠道促进出口产品清洁度的提升。异质性分析表明，数字化转型对通过ISO14001认证、主要出口目的地为欧盟以外国家以及信息披露质量高的企业的出口产品清洁度提升作用更为明显。此外，在城市环境信息披露背景下，数字化转型对出口产品清洁度的提升具有结构性效应。

articles.title_en: Exploiting the sentiments: A simple approach for improving cross hedging effectiveness
articles.title_cn: 利用情绪：一种提高交叉对冲有效性的简单方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel hedging strategy based on textual information for cross-hedging. The strategy allows the optimal hedge ratio to vary with the sentiment extracted from online oil news, leading to an improvement in cross-hedging effectiveness. We find that the sentiment hedging strategy outperforms traditional time-varying and static hedging strategies in both in-sample and out-of-sample scenarios, with statistical and economic significance. This superior performance benefits from the well-documented predictive power of sentiment on futures volatility. Furthermore, we confirm an asymmetric effect of sentiment on hedging effectiveness, with negative sentiment having a greater impact on hedge ratios. Finally, extreme sentiment can trade off the negative relationship between volatile hedge ratios and hedging performance, potentially leading to superior hedging performance compared to normal sentiment, which is robust when considering transaction costs. Our findings highlight the importance of sentiment for estimating the optimal hedge ratio and should be considered for risk management.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种基于文本信息的新型对冲策略，用于交叉对冲。该策略允许最优对冲比率随从在线石油新闻中提取的情绪变化而变化，从而提高交叉对冲的有效性。我们发现，情绪对冲策略在样本内和样本外情景中均优于传统的时变和静态对冲策略，具有统计和经济显著性。这种优越表现得益于情绪对期货波动率的预测能力，这一点已有充分文献记载。此外，我们确认了情绪对对冲有效性的不对称效应，负面情绪对对冲比率的影响更大。最后，极端情绪可以权衡波动性对冲比率与对冲绩效之间的负相关关系，可能带来优于正常情绪的对冲绩效，这在考虑交易成本时是稳健的。我们的研究结果强调了情绪在估计最优对冲比率中的重要性，应在风险管理中予以考虑。

articles.title_en: Financial warning for coal mining investments: Evidence from the fruit fly optimisation algorithm with backpropagation neural networks
articles.title_cn: 煤炭开采投资的财务预警：基于果蝇优化算法与反向传播神经网络的证据
articles.abstract_en: Venture capital firms may be unable to withstand the high investments and risks associated with coal mining exploration due to limitations in the funding scale. Risk control capability is also a challenge for venture capital companies. Finding a balance between high-risk and high-return coal mining exploration projects is a problem that venture capital companies must face. We propose a financial risk-warning model for coal mining investment enterprises based on the fruit fly optimisation algorithm (FOA) with the backpropagation neural network (BPNN). The fusion of standardised and dimensionless sample data through factor analysis reduces the input dimension of the BPNN and improves its stability. The financial warning algorithm of the model has been effectively validated through experiments. The research results indicate that its accuracy has reached a high level of financial warning, reaching a level of 95%.
articles.abstract_cn: 风险投资公司可能因资金规模限制而无法承受煤炭开采勘探相关的高投资和风险。风险控制能力对风险投资公司来说也是一个挑战。在高风险高回报的煤炭开采勘探项目中寻找平衡是风险投资公司必须面对的问题。我们提出了一种基于果蝇优化算法（FOA）和反向传播神经网络（BPNN）的煤炭开采投资企业财务风险预警模型。通过因子分析对标准化和无量纲化的样本数据进行融合，降低了BPNN的输入维度并提高了其稳定性。该模型的财务预警算法已通过实验得到有效验证。研究结果表明，其准确率已达到较高的财务预警水平，达到95%的水平。

articles.title_en: From aid to resilience: Assessing the impact of climate finance on energy vulnerability in developing countries
articles.title_cn: 从援助到韧性：评估气候融资对发展中国家能源脆弱性的影响
articles.abstract_en: Climate change is a major threat, and tackling it requires massive investment in sustainable practices and technologies. This paper explores the impact of the Global Climate Finance Fund (CF), including the Adaptation Finance Fund (AF) and Mitigation Finance Fund (MF), on energy vulnerability from 2000 to 2019 in a panel of 74 developing countries. Estimation using the Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) method showed that the CF significantly reduces energy vulnerability in developing countries. Furthermore, these results show that the MF has a greater reduction effect on energy vulnerability than the AF. To deal with the omitted variables bias and reverse causality, we applied the Oster (2019) stability test, and the Instrumental Variable Generalized Method of Moments (IV-GMM). The results confirm previous findings that climate finance reduces energy vulnerability, with mitigation finance having a larger effect. These results remained robust to the introduction of additional controls, to the exclusion of outliers, and to the use of alternative climate finance measures. Instrumenting climate finance by the share of important votes at the UN General Assembly and using three different instrumental estimation techniques, such as the Instrumental Variable Two-Stage Least Squares (IV-2SLS), Lewbel (2012), and Kiviet (2020), does not change our results. Finally, an asymmetry analysis through the application of the Canay (2011) quantile regression demonstrated that climate finance reduces energy vulnerability only for countries with a medium and high level of energy vulnerability. Based on these results, policy recommendations have been formulated.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化是一个重大威胁，应对它需要大量投资于可持续实践和技术。本文探讨了全球气候融资基金（CF），包括适应融资基金（AF）和减缓融资基金（MF），对2000年至2019年74个发展中国家面板数据中能源脆弱性的影响。使用普通最小二乘法（OLS）进行估计表明，CF显著降低了发展中国家的能源脆弱性。此外，这些结果表明，MF对能源脆弱性的降低效果大于AF。为了解决遗漏变量偏差和反向因果问题，我们应用了Oster（2019）稳定性检验和工具变量广义矩估计（IV-GMM）。结果证实了先前的发现，即气候融资降低了能源脆弱性，且减缓融资的影响更大。这些结果在引入额外控制变量、排除异常值以及使用替代气候融资指标后仍然稳健。通过联合国大会重要投票份额作为气候融资的工具变量，并使用三种不同的工具变量估计技术，如工具变量两阶段最小二乘法（IV-2SLS）、Lewbel（2012）和Kiviet（2020），我们的结果没有改变。最后，通过应用Canay（2011）分位数回归进行的非对称性分析表明，气候融资仅对中等和高能源脆弱性水平的国家降低能源脆弱性。基于这些结果，提出了政策建议。

articles.title_en: The impact of carbon policy news on the national energy industry
articles.title_cn: 碳政策新闻对国家能源行业的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the impact of unexpected changes in European carbon policy on Portugal’s energy sector, focusing on effects on sales, output prices, and labor market dynamics. Using a structural vector autoregression (SVAR) model, the study finds that news of tighter carbon regulations leads to a significant short-term increase in domestic sales. Output prices rise in both home and foreign markets, with a larger increase observed in the latter. The labor market responds positively, as evidenced by higher wages and hours worked. The study also reveals that these carbon policy changes have played a significant role in historical fluctuations within the energy sector, especially during the Great Financial Crisis and key policy changes. The findings highlight the importance of judicious policymaking concerning carbon regulations, as the escalation in energy prices wields significant economic effects, though not all of these effects are bad from the energy industry standpoint.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了欧洲碳政策的意外变化对葡萄牙能源部门的影响，重点关注对销售额、产出价格和劳动力市场动态的影响。通过使用结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型，研究发现更严格的碳监管消息会导致国内销售额在短期内显著增加。产出价格在国内和国外市场均上升，且后者涨幅更大。劳动力市场反应积极，表现为工资和工作时间的增加。研究还揭示，这些碳政策变化在能源部门的历史波动中发挥了重要作用，尤其是在大金融危机和关键政策变化期间。研究结果强调了在碳监管方面审慎决策的重要性，因为能源价格的上涨具有显著的经济效应，尽管从能源行业的角度来看，并非所有这些效应都是不利的。

articles.title_en: Energy supply chain efficiency in the digital era: Evidence from China's listed companies
articles.title_cn: 数字时代能源供应链效率：来自中国上市公司的证据
articles.abstract_en: With the widespread adoption of cutting-edge digital technologies, including big data, blockchain, artificial intelligence (AI), and cloud computing, the development and digitalization of the supply chain are experiencing significant integration. According to China's Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for a Modern Energy System, the country has embarked on a new phase of constructing a modern energy system. An accelerating trend in the digital upgrading of energy businesses marks a period of innovation and upgrading for the modern energy industry. Although policy documents highlight the role of digital technology in advancing the digital transformation of energy businesses, the underlying relationships and transmission mechanisms have yet to be fully explored, underscoring the necessity for targeted policy development. This study examines the link between enterprise digital transformation and energy supply chain efficiency, utilizing a bidirectional fixed-effects framework and analyzing data from 112 listed companies in the energy sector from 2011 to 2019. Employing a three-stage DEA model and text analysis to measure the primary indicators, findings suggest that digital transformation enhances energy supply chain efficiency by fostering technological innovation, leveraging government subsidies, and increasing openness levels. Moreover, the positive impact is more pronounced in large and private enterprises, especially in the eastern and northeastern regions. This study offers empirical support for the policy framework mentioned, advocating for the advancement of business digital transformation, the establishment and enhancement of digital supply chain systems, and the integration of supply chain enterprise resources upstream and downstream.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着大数据、区块链、人工智能（AI）和云计算等前沿数字技术的广泛采用，供应链的发展与数字化正在经历显著的融合。根据中国《“十四五”现代能源体系规划》，国家已开启建设现代能源体系的新阶段。能源企业数字化升级的加速趋势标志着现代能源产业正处于创新与升级的时期。尽管政策文件强调了数字技术在推进能源企业数字化转型中的作用，但其内在关系和传导机制尚未得到充分探讨，这凸显了制定针对性政策的必要性。本研究利用双向固定效应模型，分析2011年至2019年间112家能源行业上市公司的数据，考察企业数字化转型与能源供应链效率之间的联系。采用三阶段DEA模型和文本分析来衡量主要指标，研究发现数字化转型通过促进技术创新、利用政府补贴和提高开放水平来提升能源供应链效率。此外，这种积极影响在大型企业和民营企业中更为显著，尤其是在东部和东北地区。本研究为上述政策框架提供了实证支持，倡导推进企业数字化转型、建立和完善数字供应链体系，以及整合供应链上下游企业资源。

articles.title_en: Forecasting oil futures returns with news
articles.title_cn: 利用新闻预测石油期货收益
articles.abstract_en: This paper aims to explore the extent to which text data contains valuable information for predicting oil futures returns. A novel mixed-frequency data sampling random forest regression (MIDAS-RF) approach is proposed to construct a textual indicator. This approach can extract nonlinearity and interaction information from news and allows us to better handle the mixed-frequency and high-dimensional data. Comparing it with traditional sentiment variables and financial factors, our indicator demonstrates better forecasting performance both statistically and economically, with a monthly out-of-sample R2 of 5.26% and an annualized certainty equivalent return gain of 3.08%, respectively. Further evidence suggests that the predictability of the textual indicator is primarily driven by words related to capital markets and macroeconomic topics.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文旨在探讨文本数据在多大程度上包含预测石油期货收益的有价值信息。提出了一种新颖的混合频率数据采样随机森林回归（MIDAS-RF）方法来构建文本指标。该方法能够从新闻中提取非线性和交互信息，并使我们能够更好地处理混合频率和高维数据。与传统情绪变量和金融因素相比，我们的指标在统计上和经济上都表现出更好的预测性能，月度样本外R2为5.26%，年化确定性等价收益增益为3.08%。进一步证据表明，文本指标的可预测性主要由与资本市场和宏观经济主题相关的词汇驱动。

articles.title_en: Investments in transmission lines and storage units considering second-order stochastic dominance constraints
articles.title_cn: 考虑二阶随机占优约束的输电线路和储能单元投资
articles.abstract_en: Increasing intermittent renewable generation to meet the climate goals entails a deep transformation of current power systems. The transmission system must adapt to ensure a rapid and flexible response to the changes in the energy flows. Flexibility can be provided by reinforcing the interconnection among all the market agents and/or by installing facilities with fast response to the changes. In this work, we study the investment problem of a central planner that seeks to expand the transmission network and install storage units considering decarbonizing measures. We propose a two-stage stochastic problem with uncertainty on the demand growth and including representative days to characterize the hourly demand and renewable power variability. To obtain better expansion strategies according to a limit on the carbon emissions, second-order stochastic dominance constraints are imposed. Numerical analyses based on the power system of the Canary island (Spain) are provided. The results show that to install storage units is key to efficiently integrate renewable generation. The investments in the transmission system are mostly in lower-voltage lines. The formulation with stochastic dominance constraints results in higher second-stage investments, allowing a better adaptation to the demand growth evolution.
articles.abstract_cn: 为满足气候目标而增加间歇性可再生能源发电，需要对当前电力系统进行深度转型。输电系统必须适应能源流动的变化，以确保快速灵活的反应。灵活性可以通过加强所有市场参与者之间的互联和/或安装对变化快速响应的设施来提供。在本工作中，我们研究了一个中央规划者的投资问题，该规划者旨在扩展输电网络并安装储能单元，同时考虑脱碳措施。我们提出了一个两阶段随机问题，其中需求增长存在不确定性，并包含代表性日以刻画小时级需求和可再生能源功率的变异性。为了根据碳排放限制获得更好的扩展策略，施加了二阶随机占优约束。基于西班牙加那利群岛电力系统的数值分析得以提供。结果表明，安装储能单元对于有效整合可再生能源发电至关重要。输电系统的投资主要集中在较低电压线路上。带有随机占优约束的公式导致第二阶段投资更高，从而更好地适应需求增长的演变。

articles.title_en: Unraveling the crystal ball: Machine learning models for crude oil and natural gas volatility forecasting
articles.title_cn: 揭开水晶球之谜：用于原油和天然气波动率预测的机器学习模型
articles.abstract_en: This study aims to forecast crude oil and natural gas volatility across various forecasting horizons, from daily to quarterly, using diverse machine learning models. It critically analyzes eleven models, including Linear Regression, Elastic Regression, Ridge Regression, Lasso Regression, Huber Regression, Random Forest Regression, SVM, LSTM, GRU, ANN, and XGBoost, using RMSE for accuracy. The study reveals that model performance significantly varies with forecasting horizons; a phenomenon attributed to each model's inherent capabilities in processing short-term versus long-term market trends. This detailed understanding aids in selecting the most appropriate models for specific forecasting needs, essential for policymakers and practitioners in managing volatility effectively. The study concludes with a recommendation for using Random Forest Regression and XGBoost for natural gas volatility forecasting, providing key insights for enhancing economic resilience and stability.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在使用多种机器学习模型，预测从日度到季度的不同预测期限内的原油和天然气波动率。研究批判性地分析了十一个模型，包括线性回归、弹性回归、岭回归、套索回归、胡贝尔回归、随机森林回归、支持向量机、长短期记忆网络、门控循环单元、人工神经网络和极限梯度提升，并使用均方根误差评估准确性。研究发现，模型性能随预测期限的不同而显著变化；这一现象归因于每个模型在处理短期与长期市场趋势方面的固有能力的差异。这种详细的理解有助于针对特定的预测需求选择最合适的模型，对于政策制定者和从业者有效管理波动率至关重要。研究最后建议使用随机森林回归和极限梯度提升进行天然气波动率预测，为增强经济韧性和稳定性提供了关键见解。

articles.title_en: A time-frequency-based interval decomposition ensemble method for forecasting gasoil prices under the trend of low-carbon development
articles.title_cn: 低碳发展趋势下基于时频区间分解集成方法的柴油价格预测
articles.abstract_en: Given that gasoil plays a crucial role in carbon emission reduction, in this paper we propose a time-frequency-based interval decomposition ensemble (TFIDE) learning approach to forecast gasoil prices and capture the nonlinear impact of the global trend of low-carbon development on gasoil prices. The proposed method integrates bivariate empirical mode decomposition (BEMD), an interval multilayer perceptron (IMLP) network and a threshold autoregressive interval (TARI) model. First, we use BEMD to decompose interval-valued weekly gasoil prices into a finite number of complex-valued intrinsic mode function (IMF) components and a residual component. Second, we apply the IMLP model to forecast the IMFs and the TARI model to predict the residual part with predictors of carbon reduction technology and carbon emission concerns. After that, we combine all the forecasting results to generate the final gasoil price interval forecasting results. Our empirical results show that our carbon reduction technology variable improves middle-frequency IMF forecasting and that carbon emission concerns have a nonlinear impact on long-term gasoil price intervals. Furthermore, the proposed TFIDE approach outperforms other competing methods under different accuracy measurements.
articles.abstract_cn: 鉴于柴油在碳减排中扮演关键角色，本文提出一种基于时频的区间分解集成（TFIDE）学习方法，以预测柴油价格并捕捉全球低碳发展趋势对柴油价格的非线性影响。该方法整合了二元经验模态分解（BEMD）、区间多层感知器（IMLP）网络和阈值自回归区间（TARI）模型。首先，我们使用BEMD将区间值的周度柴油价格分解为有限个复值固有模态函数（IMF）分量和一个残差分量。其次，我们应用IMLP模型预测IMFs，并使用TARI模型预测残差部分，其中预测变量包括碳减排技术和碳排放关注度。之后，我们组合所有预测结果以生成最终的柴油价格区间预测结果。我们的实证结果表明，碳减排技术变量改善了中频IMF预测，而碳排放关注度对长期柴油价格区间具有非线性影响。此外，在不同精度度量下，所提出的TFIDE方法优于其他竞争方法。

articles.title_en: Transmission planning in an imperfectly competitive power sector with environmental externalities
articles.title_cn: 具有环境外部性的不完全竞争电力部门中的输电规划
articles.abstract_en: Policymakers face the challenge of integrating intermittent output from variable renewable energy (VRE). Even in a well-functioning power sector with flexible generation, producers’ incentives may not align with society’s welfare-maximisation objective. At the same time, political pressure can obstruct policymakers from pricing damage from CO2 emissions according to its social costs. In facilitating decarbonisation, transmission planning will have to adapt to such economic and environmental distortions. Using a Stackelberg model of the Nordic power sector, we find that a first-best transmission-expansion plan involves better resource sharing between zones, which actually reduces the need for some VRE adoption. Next, we allow for departures from perfect competition and identify an extended transmission-expansion plan under market power by nuclear plants. By contrast, temporal arbitrage by hydro reservoirs does not necessitate transmission expansion beyond that of perfect competition because it incentivises sufficient VRE adoption using existing lines. Meanwhile, incomplete CO2 pricing under perfect competition requires a transmission plan that matches hydro-rich zones with sites for VRE adoption. However, since incomplete CO2 pricing leaves fossil-fuelled generation economically viable, it reduces the leverage of strategic producers, thereby catalysing less (more) extensive transmission expansion under market power by nuclear (hydro) plants.
articles.abstract_cn: 政策制定者面临整合可变可再生能源（VRE）间歇性输出的挑战。即使在运行良好且具有灵活发电的电力部门中，生产者的激励也可能与社会福利最大化的目标不一致。同时，政治压力可能阻碍政策制定者按照社会成本对二氧化碳排放造成的损害进行定价。在促进脱碳过程中，输电规划必须适应此类经济和环境扭曲。使用北欧电力部门的Stackelberg模型，我们发现最优的输电扩建计划涉及区域间更好的资源共享，这实际上减少了对某些VRE采用的需求。接下来，我们允许偏离完全竞争，并识别出在核电企业市场势力下的扩展输电扩建计划。相比之下，水电水库的时间套利不需要超出完全竞争情况下的输电扩建，因为它利用现有线路激励了足够的VRE采用。同时，在完全竞争下不完整的二氧化碳定价需要一种输电计划，将水电丰富的区域与VRE采用的地点相匹配。然而，由于不完整的二氧化碳定价使化石燃料发电在经济上可行，它降低了战略生产者的杠杆作用，从而在核电（水电）企业市场势力下催化了较少（较多）的输电扩建。

articles.title_en: Integrated geo-techno-economic and real options analysis of the decision to invest in a medium enthalpy deep geothermal heating plant. A case study in Northern Belgium
articles.title_cn: 中焓深层地热供暖厂投资决策的综合地质-技术-经济与实物期权分析：比利时北部案例研究
articles.abstract_en: Deep geothermal energy (DGE) is a renewable energy source that is considered to cause a low global warming impact. The potential of DGE for heating is widespread and interest in deep geothermal heating (DGH) has been growing in Europe to help achieving the decarbonization of the heating mix. Nevertheless, despite its large potential, DGH development in Europe remains underexplored. DGH investments are hindered by the risks born by geological and market uncertainties. However, various flexibility options inherent to the development process, such as the option to abandon or defer, could partly mitigate these risks. To account for managerial flexibility in the investment analysis, this study suggests a novel real options (RO) framework. The RO model splits DGH development into five phases, and considers several compound options and geological and market uncertainties to investigate the timing and value of DGH development at the Campine Basin in Northern Belgium. The RO model is coupled to a geo-techno-economic model and is solved using the Least Squares Monte Carlo algorithm. The RO analysis finds a 51% probability of abandonment and an average deferral time for the development of 12 years. The abandon option mitigates the risk of large financial losses in case of inadequate geological conditions. The defer option allows the investors to wait for more favorable market conditions before investing, to increase the project value. The results show that DGH development in the investigated area is not economically desirable. However, the investors' flexibility increases the project value by 12.16 million EUR, compared to a conventional techno-economic analysis. The implementation of supporting policy measures improves the economic performance of the plant. The consideration of flexibility leads to supporting policy measures with 3–4 times lower governmental expenditure, compared to a conventional techno-economic analysis. This study shows that a RO approach is more suitable to investigate DGH investments than static techno-economic methods. The inclusion of flexibility allows for identifying development pathways that increase the project value and for designing more cost-efficient supporting policy schemes.
articles.abstract_cn: 深层地热能（DGE）是一种可再生能源，被认为对全球变暖影响较低。DGE用于供暖的潜力广泛，欧洲对深层地热供暖（DGH）的兴趣日益增长，以帮助实现供暖结构的脱碳。然而，尽管潜力巨大，欧洲的DGH开发仍未被充分探索。DGH投资受到地质和市场不确定性带来的风险阻碍。然而，开发过程中固有的各种灵活性选项，如放弃或延迟的期权，可以部分缓解这些风险。为了在投资分析中考虑管理灵活性，本研究提出了一种新颖的实物期权（RO）框架。RO模型将DGH开发分为五个阶段，并考虑多个复合期权以及地质和市场不确定性，以研究比利时北部Campine盆地DGH开发的时间和价值。RO模型与地质-技术-经济模型耦合，并使用最小二乘蒙特卡洛算法求解。RO分析发现，放弃概率为51%%，开发的平均延迟时间为12年。放弃期权减轻了地质条件不足时重大财务损失的风险。延迟期权允许投资者在投资前等待更有利的市场条件，以增加项目价值。结果表明，所研究区域的DGH开发在经济上并不可取。然而，投资者的灵活性使项目价值增加了12.16百万欧元，相比传统技术经济分析。支持性政策措施的实施改善了工厂的经济绩效。考虑灵活性后，支持性政策措施的政府支出比传统技术经济分析低3-4倍。本研究表明，RO方法比静态技术经济方法更适合研究DGH投资。灵活性的纳入有助于识别增加项目价值的发展路径，并设计更具成本效益的支持性政策方案。

articles.title_en: Climate change and crude oil prices: An interval forecast model with interval-valued textual data
articles.title_cn: 气候变化与原油价格：基于区间值文本数据的区间预测模型
articles.abstract_en: Climate change compels the development and enforcement of policies and regulations designed to diminish carbon emissions, imposing substantial implications on the energy sector. Given the contribution of crude oil prices to carbon emissions, developing precise forecasting methods is imperative. However, existing studies often overlook the inherent uncertainty in price movements by focusing solely on point forecasting. To address this limitation, this paper constructs a threshold autoregressive interval-valued model with interval sentiment indexes for climate change (TARIX) to analyze and forecast interval-valued crude oil prices. We have found that the interval climate sentiment index, derived from social media, can significantly enhance the accuracy in forecasting interval crude oil prices. Moreover, we propose an interval-based trading strategy that can effectively reduce volatility and enhance returns. Our empirical results demonstrate that our interval-valued forecast model outperforms traditional forecasting methods in terms of forecasting accuracy and profit generation.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化推动制定和实施旨在减少碳排放的政策与法规，对能源部门产生重大影响。鉴于原油价格对碳排放的贡献，开发精确的预测方法至关重要。然而，现有研究往往仅关注点预测，忽视了价格变动中固有的不确定性。为解决这一局限，本文构建了一个带有气候变化区间情绪指数的阈值自回归区间值模型（TARIX），用于分析和预测区间值原油价格。我们发现，源自社交媒体的区间气候情绪指数能显著提高区间原油价格预测的准确性。此外，我们提出了一种基于区间的交易策略，可有效降低波动性并提高收益。我们的实证结果表明，我们的区间值预测模型在预测准确性和利润生成方面优于传统预测方法。

articles.title_en: A win-win relationship? New evidence on artificial intelligence and new energy vehicles
articles.title_cn: 双赢关系？人工智能与新能源汽车的新证据
articles.abstract_en: Investigating the vital role of artificial intelligence is essential to develop the electric vehicle market. This study utilises the wavelet-based QQR methodology to seize the dynamic correlation of artificial intelligence index (AII) and electric vehicle indicator (EVI). Based on quantitative deliberations, the favourable effects of AII on EVI at low-low and high-high quantiles and adverse impacts at high-low and low-high quantiles in the short run confirm the role of artificial intelligence in facilitating the electric vehicle market. However, the favourable effect of AII at medium to high quantiles on EVI at low quantiles refutes it because of the crowding-out effect. Conversely, the positive impact of EVI at medium to high quantiles on AII at low to medium quantiles ascertains the crowding-out effect of electric vehicles, while AII at medium to high quantiles cannot agree on it due to safety and convenience needs. In the mid-to-long term, the interactions of AII and EVI are gradually weakened, and speculative behaviours, crowding-out effects, and safety concerns drive the different cases. Therefore, a win-win situation between them does not always hold, and recommendations are being offered to enhance the significance of artificial intelligence in electric vehicles under the new round of scientific and technological revolution.
articles.abstract_cn: 研究人工智能的关键作用对于发展电动汽车市场至关重要。本研究采用基于小波的QQR方法，捕捉人工智能指数（AII）与电动汽车指标（EVI）之间的动态相关性。基于定量考量，短期内AII对EVI在低-低和高-高分位数上的有利影响，以及在高-低和低-高分位数上的不利影响，证实了人工智能在促进电动汽车市场中的作用。然而，由于挤出效应，AII在中高位数对EVI低分位数的有利影响被否定。相反，EVI在中高位数对AII低至中分位数的正向影响证实了电动汽车的挤出效应，而AII在中高位数因安全和便利需求而无法认同。在中长期，AII与EVI的相互作用逐渐减弱，投机行为、挤出效应和安全担忧导致了不同情况。因此，它们之间的双赢局面并非总是成立，本文提出了在新一轮科技革命中增强人工智能在电动汽车中重要性的建议。

articles.title_en: Analyzing Crisis Dynamics: How metal-energy Markets influence green electricity investments
articles.title_cn: 分析危机动态：金属-能源市场如何影响绿色电力投资
articles.abstract_en: The world continues to face major economic challenges due to crises that have a considerable impact on energy consumption. Since the global energy crisis, energy commodity costs have risen, and economic slowdowns in various regions continue to influence electricity market trends. Clean energy markets, propelled by the growing interest of economic entities and investors, are now interconnected with several commodity markets. In this context, energy metals play a crucial role in influencing the dynamics of the clean energy and particularly electricity markets. This study takes a close look at the complex interconnections between clean energy indices and the metals market, focusing on volatility dynamics. Drawing on advanced methodologies, including the Diebold and Yilmaz method, we unveil the complex relationships that link these markets. Our results reveal distinct patterns and interactions, highlighting the nuanced nature of the connection between clean energy indices and metal prices. The insights revealed have significant implications for policymakers and investors seeking to align their strategies with sustainable energy transitions and ensure financial stability. By enhancing our understanding of the interdependencies between clean energy indices and metals markets, this research provides valuable guidance for navigating the changing clean energy investment landscape.
articles.abstract_cn: 世界持续面临重大经济挑战，这些挑战源于对能源消费产生显著影响的危机。自全球能源危机以来，能源商品成本上升，各地区的经济放缓持续影响电力市场趋势。清洁能源市场在经济实体和投资者兴趣增长的推动下，现已与多个商品市场相互关联。在此背景下，能源金属在影响清洁能源特别是电力市场动态方面发挥着关键作用。本研究深入探讨了清洁能源指数与金属市场之间的复杂联系，重点关注波动性动态。借助包括Diebold和Yilmaz方法在内的先进方法论，我们揭示了连接这些市场的复杂关系。我们的结果揭示了不同的模式和相互作用，突出了清洁能源指数与金属价格之间联系的细微差别。所揭示的见解对寻求将其战略与可持续能源转型对齐并确保金融稳定的政策制定者和投资者具有重要意义。通过增强我们对清洁能源指数与金属市场之间相互依赖关系的理解，本研究为应对不断变化的清洁能源投资格局提供了宝贵指导。

articles.title_en: Are artificial intelligence and blockchain the key to unlocking the box of clean energy?
articles.title_cn: 人工智能和区块链是打开清洁能源之箱的钥匙吗？
articles.abstract_en: The fourth industrial revolution has brought about key technological breakthroughs represented by artificial intelligence (AI) and blockchain (BC), which provide an opportunity for the development of clean energy (CE). We employ a wavelet-based quantile-on-quantile approach to investigate the correlation among AI, BC and CE over different periods and time horizons. The results show that although the integration of AI and CE systems requires a lot of time, it can significantly boost CE development in the long run. However, BC cannot significantly promote CE development except for a few extreme periods. Our results are supported by the mechanism of interaction among AI, BC and CE development, which highlights their relationship. Therefore, the government should focus on promoting the development of new information technologies and their integration with the CE system, which is crucial for the implementation of energy transition strategies. In addition, low-carbon investors should focus on these technologies because of their relationship with CE.
articles.abstract_cn: 第四次工业革命带来了以人工智能（AI）和区块链（BC）为代表的关键技术突破，为清洁能源（CE）的发展提供了机遇。我们采用基于小波的分位数对分位数方法，研究AI、BC和CE在不同时期和时间范围内的相关性。结果表明，尽管AI与CE系统的整合需要大量时间，但从长远来看，它可以显著促进CE的发展。然而，除了少数极端时期外，BC并不能显著促进CE的发展。我们的结果得到了AI、BC和CE发展之间相互作用机制的支持，这凸显了它们之间的关系。因此，政府应重点推动新一代信息技术的发展及其与CE系统的融合，这对于实施能源转型战略至关重要。此外，低碳投资者应关注这些技术，因为它们与CE相关。

articles.title_en: The impact of political leader's absence on air quality
articles.title_cn: 政治领导人缺席对空气质量的影响
articles.abstract_en: Despite a significant amount of academic interest in politicians, there is little empirical research on the impact of their absence on the air quality in the areas under their jurisdiction. This study therefore examines the impact of city leaders' absence on local air quality. Using hand-collected data in Chinese cities from 2003 to 2018, we find that a city leader's absence reduces air pollutant emissions and improves air quality. We also identify two potential channels through which this happens: the disrupted collusion between local leaders and enterprises; and reduced investment. Finally, our findings suggest that the positive relationship between a city leader's absence and improved air quality is attenuated in regions with a better legal environment and stronger religiosity. Our findings provide practical insights for the central government and policymakers to resolve a serious environmental crisis and increase local implementation capacities in environmental governance.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管学术界对政治人物有大量兴趣，但关于其缺席对其管辖区域空气质量影响的实证研究却很少。因此，本研究考察了城市领导人缺席对当地空气质量的影响。利用手工收集的2003年至2018年中国城市数据，我们发现城市领导人的缺席减少了空气污染物排放并改善了空气质量。我们还识别了两种可能的渠道：地方领导人与企业之间被破坏的合谋；以及投资减少。最后，我们的研究结果表明，城市领导人缺席与空气质量改善之间的正相关关系在法律环境更好和宗教性更强的地区会减弱。我们的发现为中央政府和政策制定者解决严重环境危机和提高地方环境治理执行能力提供了实际见解。

articles.title_en: The effect of the county-to-district conversion policy on energy efficiency of enterprises: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 撤县设区政策对企业能源效率的影响：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Enhancing the energy efficiency of enterprises is of paramount significance not only in addressing energy scarcity and environmental pollution issues but also in achieving the crucial objectives of carbon neutrality. Our paper utilizes the staggered Difference-in-Differences (DID) approach to accurately identify the causal effect of the adjustment of administrative division (county-to-district conversion) on the energy efficiency of enterprises in the affected regions, contributing valuable insights to the broader field of regional economic development and energy-saving policy formulation. The empirical analysis reveals that the county-to-district conversion reform has resulted in a noteworthy decline in energy efficiency among enterprises within the reformed counties compared to their comparable counterparts. Further mechanism analysis reveals that county-to-district conversion policy led to a reduction in government subsidies, an increase in tax burdens, and heightened debt costs, thereby diminishing the energy efficiency of enterprises. Heterogeneous tests from the government's perspective indicate that enterprises located in strong counties, those situated in areas with higher degree of dependence on land finance, and those facing less pressure for energy conservation and emission reduction experience a greater pronounced decline in energy efficiency. Our research outcomes emphasize the necessity of moving away from resource-intensive growth approaches and embracing strategies that promote high-quality development.
articles.abstract_cn: 提高企业能源效率不仅对解决能源短缺和环境污染问题至关重要，而且对实现碳中和的关键目标也具有重要意义。本文利用交错双重差分法（DID）准确识别行政区划调整（撤县设区）对受影响地区企业能源效率的因果效应，为区域经济发展和节能政策制定的更广泛领域提供了有价值的见解。实证分析表明，与可比对照组相比，撤县设区改革导致改革县内企业的能源效率显著下降。进一步的机制分析显示，撤县设区政策导致政府补贴减少、税收负担增加和债务成本上升，从而降低了企业的能源效率。从政府角度的异质性检验表明，位于强县的企业、位于土地财政依赖程度较高地区的企业以及面临节能减排压力较小的企业，其能源效率下降更为显著。我们的研究结果强调了摆脱资源密集型增长方式、拥抱促进高质量发展战略的必要性。

articles.title_en: Factor reallocation path for low-carbon transformation: A perspective of manufacturing industry ecosystem
articles.title_cn: 低碳转型的要素重新配置路径：制造业生态系统视角
articles.abstract_en: The incomplete production factor market induces more factors flowing to industries with lower carbon productivity, highlighting the need for effective factor reallocation to promote low-carbon transformation. Current research is constrained by the dimension of factor endowments, with insufficient attention given to the problem of diminishing marginal benefit of factor input in factor reallocation. By combining the factor flow effect induced by productivity difference with the factor allocation equilibrium effect under diminishing marginal benefit, the factor reallocation path for low-carbon transformation is analyzed using random forest algorithm within a high-dimensional data environment from the perspective of manufacturing industry ecosystem. The results indicate that effective factor reallocation for low-carbon transformation depends on breaking the dual segmentation of factors between regions and industries to facilitate flow of factors from shrub layer industries to canopy layer industries. Adjusting key factor combinations to fall within the optimal equilibrium interval of S-shaped or anti S-shaped partial dependence curves maximizes the marginal benefits of low-carbon transformation. Industries must upgrade their factor endowment structure to accumulate essential carrying capacities that support advanced manufacturing, leveraging the low-carbon transformation dividends of advanced factors inflow and technology spillover. Otherwise, aligning with regional factor comparative advantage to cultivate differentiated characteristic manufacturing industries offers a promising alternative, capitalizing on the low-carbon efficiency premium derived from specialized division of labor.
articles.abstract_cn: 不完善的生产要素市场导致更多要素流向低碳生产率较低的行业，凸显了有效要素重新配置以促进低碳转型的必要性。当前研究受要素禀赋维度限制，对要素重新配置中要素投入边际收益递减问题的关注不足。通过将生产率差异引致的要素流动效应与边际收益递减下的要素配置均衡效应相结合，从制造业生态系统视角，在高维数据环境下利用随机森林算法分析低碳转型的要素重新配置路径。结果表明，低碳转型的有效要素重新配置取决于打破要素在区域和行业间的双重分割，促进要素从灌木层行业向冠层行业流动。调整关键要素组合落入S形或反S形偏依赖图的最优均衡区间，可最大化低碳转型的边际收益。行业必须升级其要素禀赋结构，积累支持先进制造业的必要承载能力，利用先进要素流入和技术溢出的低碳转型红利。否则，顺应区域要素比较优势培育差异化特色制造业是一种有前景的替代方案，可利用专业化分工带来的低碳效率溢价。

articles.title_en: Polluted air, smarter factories? China's robot imports shed light on a potential link
articles.title_cn: 污染空气，更智能的工厂？中国机器人进口揭示潜在联系
articles.abstract_en: Robot-centered intelligent manufacturing is leading a new round of technological revolution and industrial change. Existing studies have neglected the impact of air pollution, a non-monetary factor, on firms' intelligent manufacturing transformation (FIMT). Using matched samples from China's industrial enterprise database and China's customs database, and based on enterprises' “machine replacing human” strategy, this paper reveals the facilitating effect of air pollution on FIMT. The robustness estimation results after endogeneity treatment, replacing the core variables, changing the clustering level, removing the policy influence, avoiding the interference of domestic robots, changing the estimation strategy, and restricting the import trade mode still support the conclusion. The mechanism by which air pollution accelerates FIMT lies in the first: the factor substitution effect of rising labor costs due to air pollution. The second is the skill-capital complementarity effect due to increased firms' human capital investment induced by air pollution. The third is the intelligent investment effect due to increased economic policy uncertainty induced by air pollution. In addition, air pollution accelerates FIMT more significantly in non-state-owned firms, high labor-intensity industries, and regions with high population aging. This paper argues that there is no conflict between environmental governance and intelligent manufacturing transformation. Air pollution and “machines replacing humans” in the labor market efficiency and fairness issues need attention.
articles.abstract_cn: 以机器人为中心的智能制造正在引领新一轮技术革命和产业变革。现有研究忽视了空气污染这一非货币因素对企业智能制造转型（FIMT）的影响。利用中国工业企业数据库和中国海关数据库的匹配样本，并基于企业“机器换人”战略，本文揭示了空气污染对FIMT的促进作用。经过内生性处理、替换核心变量、改变聚类层级、排除政策影响、避免国内机器人干扰、改变估计策略以及限制进口贸易模式后的稳健性估计结果仍支持该结论。空气污染加速FIMT的机制在于：第一，空气污染导致劳动力成本上升的要素替代效应；第二，空气污染诱导企业人力资本投资增加带来的技能-资本互补效应；第三，空气污染诱导经济政策不确定性增加带来的智能投资效应。此外，空气污染对FIMT的加速作用在非国有企业、高劳动密集型行业以及人口老龄化程度高的地区更为显著。本文认为环境治理与智能制造转型之间并不存在冲突。空气污染与劳动力市场中“机器换人”的效率和公平问题需要关注。

articles.title_en: The rebound effect of material and energy efficiency for the EU and its major trading partners
articles.title_cn: 欧盟及其主要贸易伙伴的物质与能源效率的回弹效应
articles.abstract_en: This study presents a comprehensive analysis and comparison of material and energy efficiency performances and their rebound effects, providing insights into their implications for sustainability and climate change policies. Using Stochastic Frontier Analysis (SFA), we examine material and energy efficiency scores and rebound effects in the European Union (EU) member countries and their major trading partners from 1995 to 2019. Our findings reveal several key insights. Firstly, developed EU countries and affluent trading partners exhibit higher material and energy efficiency scores, while less developed members and partners rank lower. The study highlights the potential implications of the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) for low-efficiency trading partners, which may face substantial penalties and be incentivized to take significant steps to enhance material and energy efficiency. Secondly, a positive correlation is observed between efficiency improvements and rebound effects, suggesting that policymakers should take the rebound issue seriously. Thirdly, while energy efficiency scores are relatively higher, material efficiency performances are lower and improving over the years. Finally, the rebound effects of energy efficiency exceed those of material efficiency, implying that energy reduction potentials are largely offset. Therefore, prioritizing material consumption for environmental sustainability becomes crucial due to the significant potential for improvement with lower rebound effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究对物质和能源效率表现及其回弹效应进行了全面分析和比较，为可持续性和气候变化政策提供了见解。使用随机前沿分析（SFA），我们考察了1995年至2019年欧盟成员国及其主要贸易伙伴的物质和能源效率得分及回弹效应。我们的发现揭示了几个关键见解。首先，发达的欧盟国家和富裕的贸易伙伴表现出更高的物质和能源效率得分，而欠发达的成员国和伙伴排名较低。研究强调了欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）对低效率贸易伙伴的潜在影响，这些伙伴可能面临实质性惩罚，并被激励采取重大措施以提高物质和能源效率。其次，效率提升与回弹效应之间观察到正相关关系，表明政策制定者应认真对待回弹问题。第三，虽然能源效率得分相对较高，但物质效率表现较低且逐年改善。最后，能源效率的回弹效应超过物质效率的回弹效应，意味着能源减排潜力在很大程度上被抵消。因此，由于物质消耗具有显著的改进潜力和较低的回弹效应，优先考虑物质消费对于环境可持续性变得至关重要。

articles.title_en: Optimal production decision of hybrid power generation enterprises in multi-quota policy coupled markets
articles.title_cn: 多配额政策耦合市场下混合发电企业的最优生产决策
articles.abstract_en: At present, China is adopting both Carbon Emission Trading (CET) and Tradable Green Certificate (TGC) markets to optimize the resource allocation of its power industry. To mitigate the impacts of the above dual markets, more and more power generation enterprises are adopting hybrid production mode, generating electricity from thermal and new energy units simultaneously. In these complex production and market conditions, enterprises are difficult to arrange their generation activities. This research describes the production decision process of hybrid power generation enterprises with different market positions, obtains their optimal yield, and then offers market equilibrium results. In addition, the consequences of enterprise collusion behaviors and government interventions are also measured. Numerical experiment results confirm the correctness of the production decision model and reveal the following facts: 1) CET and TGC markets effectively control the carbon emission level and promote the consumption of new energy, but magnify the failure of electricity market to a certain extent. 2) CET and TGC markets promote each other in function. The existence of one market can help the other to achieve the anticipated goal. 3) Enterprises first offset the impact of market condition changes by adjusting the share of new energy generation, and then digest the residual influence by adjusting the total power generation. 4) Enterprise collusion behaviors aggravate the welfare loss of electricity consumer and then lower the expected effects of CET and TGC markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 目前，中国正在同时采用碳排放交易（CET）和可交易绿色证书（TGC）市场来优化其电力行业的资源配置。为了减轻上述双重市场的影响，越来越多的发电企业采用混合生产模式，同时利用火电和新能源机组发电。在这些复杂的生产和市场条件下，企业难以安排其发电活动。本研究描述了具有不同市场地位的混合发电企业的生产决策过程，获得了它们的最优产量，并提供了市场均衡结果。此外，还衡量了企业合谋行为和政府干预的后果。数值实验的结果证实了生产决策模型的正确性，并揭示了以下事实：1）CET和TGC市场有效控制了碳排放水平并促进了新能源的消费，但在一定程度上放大了电力市场的失灵。2）CET和TGC市场在功能上相互促进。一个市场的存在可以帮助另一个市场实现预期目标。3）企业首先通过调整新能源发电份额来抵消市场条件变化的影响，然后通过调整总发电量来消化剩余影响。4）企业合谋行为加剧了电力消费者的福利损失，并降低了CET和TGC市场的预期效果。

articles.title_en: Identifying price bubbles in global carbon markets: Evidence from the SADF test, GSADF test and LPPLS method
articles.title_cn: 识别全球碳市场价格泡沫：来自SADF检验、GSADF检验和LPPLS方法的证据
articles.abstract_en: Amid growing climate concerns, Emissions Trading Schemes (ETS) serve as key mechanisms for reducing greenhouse gas emissions through market forces. This study delves into the phenomenon of price bubbles within six major ETSs globally: the European Union Emissions Trading Scheme (EU ETS), the New Zealand Emissions Trading Scheme (NZ ETS), the California-Québec Emissions Trading Scheme (CQ ETS), the South Korea Emissions Trading Schemes (K-ETS), the China Emissions Trading Scheme (C-ETS), and the United Kingdom Emissions Trading Schemes (UK ETS). Employing the sup augmented Dickey-Fuller (SADF) test, generalized sup ADF (GSADF) test, and log-periodic power law singularity (LPPLS) model, our analysis aims to uncover the dynamics and implications of these bubbles. Our findings reveal varied patterns of price bubbles across the schemes, with the EU ETS showing the highest frequency and the NZ ETS exhibiting the longest durations. The period of 2021 and 2022 marked a significant increase in bubble occurrences across all ETSs, suggesting the influence of post-COVID-19 economic recovery and geopolitical tensions on market stability. These bubbles are attributed to factors including carbon market policies, macroeconomic conditions, energy price fluctuations, and market uncertainties. The study offers valuable insights for compliance firms, policymakers, and investors on navigating carbon market volatility. Understanding bubble dynamics can aid in formulating more effective emission reduction strategies, carbon pricing policies, and investment decisions. This research underscores the importance of integrating monetary policy considerations with environmental objectives within ETS frameworks, paving the way for future research on predictive bubble detection and the development of robust carbon market regulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 在气候问题日益受到关注的背景下，排放交易体系（ETS）作为通过市场力量减少温室气体排放的关键机制。本研究深入探讨了全球六大主要ETS中的价格泡沫现象：欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）、新西兰排放交易体系（NZ ETS）、加利福尼亚-魁北克排放交易体系（CQ ETS）、韩国排放交易体系（K-ETS）、中国排放交易体系（C-ETS）和英国排放交易体系（UK ETS）。采用sup增强Dickey-Fuller（SADF）检验、广义sup ADF（GSADF）检验和对数周期幂律奇异性（LPPLS）模型，我们的分析旨在揭示这些泡沫的动态和影响。我们的研究结果揭示了各体系价格泡沫的不同模式，其中EU ETS显示出最高的频率，而NZ ETS表现出最长的持续时间。2021年和2022年期间，所有ETS的泡沫发生次数显著增加，表明后COVID-19经济复苏和地缘政治紧张局势对市场稳定性的影响。这些泡沫归因于碳市场政策、宏观经济状况、能源价格波动和市场不确定性等因素。该研究为合规企业、政策制定者和投资者应对碳市场波动提供了宝贵的见解。理解泡沫动态有助于制定更有效的减排战略、碳定价政策和投资决策。本研究强调了在ETS框架内将货币政策考虑与环境目标相结合的重要性，为未来关于预测性泡沫检测和健全碳市场监管发展的研究铺平了道路。

articles.title_en: ynamic time-domain and frequency-domain spillovers and portfolio strategies between climate change attention and energy-relevant markets
articles.title_cn: 气候变化关注与能源相关市场之间的动态时域和频域溢出效应及投资组合策略
articles.abstract_en: We combine the Diebold and Yilmaz (DY) method, Baruník and Křehlík (BK) method and TVP-VAR model to explore the time-domain and frequency-domain spillover effects among climate change attention, oil, new energy, clean energy, solar energy, wind energy, technology, and finance. Empirical results demonstrate that the spillover effect of climate change attention and energy-relevant market is significant. At different time frequencies, risk transmission occurs more frequently in the short-term. On average, oil, solar energy, wind energy, and finance are net receivers. Finally, based on the DCC-GARCH t-copula model, we achieve optimal hedging ratios, optimal portfolio weights, and hedging effectiveness between climate change attention and energy-relevant markets. Empirical results suggest that investors incorporate climate change attention into their investment portfolios.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们结合Diebold和Yilmaz（DY）方法、Baruník和Křehlík（BK）方法以及TVP-VAR模型，探讨气候变化关注、石油、新能源、清洁能源、太阳能、风能、科技和金融之间的时域和频域溢出效应。实证结果表明，气候变化关注与能源相关市场之间的溢出效应显著。在不同时间频率下，风险传递在短期内更为频繁。平均而言，石油、太阳能、风能和金融是净接收者。最后，基于DCC-GARCH t-copula模型，我们实现了气候变化关注与能源相关市场之间的最优对冲比率、最优投资组合权重和对冲有效性。实证结果表明，投资者应将气候变化关注纳入其投资组合中。

articles.title_en: Quantum carbon finance: Carbon emission rights option pricing and investment decision
articles.title_cn: 量子碳金融：碳排放权期权定价与投资决策
articles.abstract_en: The carbon emission rights option (CERO), as a real option, can be used to measure market volatility risk and help enterprises obtain income. However, traditional option pricing models mostly operate under risk neutrality and are unsuitable for CERO pricing. Quantum finance, as a branch of economic physics, can effectively improve the uncertain behavior of financial markets. Therefore, in order to obtain more reasonable results, the study designs a quantum Monte Carlo simulation method for pricing CERO under risk uncertainty. Firstly, real options theory, quantum computing, Monte Carlo simulation, and stochastic volatility (SV) model are combined to achieve quantum state preparation and payoff calculation on quantum circuits. Then, quantum algorithms are used to achieve CERO dynamic pricing. Finally, a case study is conducted using data from the Beijing Green Exchange to verify the convergence and rationality of Quantum amplitude estimation (QAE) and its optimization algorithm in CERO pricing. The study results indicate that among the four QAE algorithms adopted, the results of two quantum algorithms are close to the traditional method and have good convergence. Compared to traditional method, the study solves the problem of difficult parameter determination in CERO pricing and reduces the results subjectivity. However, not all quantum algorithms are suitable for CERO pricing. The study further designed various carbon emission trading decisions among enterprises based on pricing results, providing a new approach for the management and operation of carbon assets in enterprises.
articles.abstract_cn: 碳排放权期权（CERO）作为一种实物期权，可用于衡量市场波动风险并帮助企业获得收益。然而，传统期权定价模型大多在风险中性条件下运作，不适用于CERO定价。量子金融作为经济物理学的一个分支，能够有效改善金融市场的不确定性行为。因此，为了获得更合理的结果，研究设计了一种在风险不确定性下对CERO进行定价的量子蒙特卡洛模拟方法。首先，将实物期权理论、量子计算、蒙特卡洛模拟和随机波动率（SV）模型相结合，在量子电路上实现量子态制备和收益计算。然后，利用量子算法实现CERO动态定价。最后，使用北京绿色交易所的数据进行案例研究，以验证量子振幅估计（QAE）及其优化算法在CERO定价中的收敛性和合理性。研究结果表明，在所采用的四种QAE算法中，两种量子算法的结果接近传统方法且具有良好的收敛性。与传统方法相比，该研究解决了CERO定价中参数确定困难的问题，并降低了结果的主观性。然而，并非所有量子算法都适用于CERO定价。研究进一步基于定价结果设计了企业间的多种碳排放权交易决策，为企业碳资产的管理和运营提供了新途径。

articles.title_en: Is the carbon emission trading scheme conducive to promoting energy transition? Some empirical evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 碳排放交易体系是否有利于促进能源转型？来自中国的实证证据
articles.abstract_en: The Carbon Emissions Trading Scheme, an important market-driven environmental regulating tool, which will significantly impact China's achievement of its “30·60 Dual-Carbon Target, can also be seen as promoting and accelerating the energy transition. This study investigates the influence of the Carbon Emissions Trading Scheme on energy transition using the difference-in-differences model and presents evidence for the effectiveness of the Carbon Emissions Trading Scheme in energy transition using the propensity score matching method and other robustness testing methods, using provincial data of China from 2010 to 2016. The results demonstrate that: (1) the Carbon Emissions Trading Scheme has promoted approximately 4.6% of the energy transition; (2) the robustness analysis reveal the beneficial function of the Carbon Emissions Trading Scheme in the energy transition; and (3) the mechanism analysis identifies technological innovation and financial decarbonization as two critical impact pathways. Finally, based on the research results of our study, we provide corresponding policy implications for improving China's Carbon Emissions Trading Scheme and accelerating the energy transition.
articles.abstract_cn: 碳排放交易体系作为一种重要的市场驱动型环境规制工具，将显著影响中国实现“30·60”双碳目标，同时也可被视为促进和加速能源转型的手段。本研究利用2010年至2016年中国省级数据，采用双重差分模型考察碳排放交易体系对能源转型的影响，并通过倾向得分匹配法及其他稳健性检验方法，为碳排放交易体系在能源转型中的有效性提供证据。结果表明：（1）碳排放交易体系促进了约4.6%的能源转型；（2）稳健性分析揭示了碳排放交易体系在能源转型中的积极作用；（3）机制分析识别出技术创新和金融脱碳两条关键影响路径。最后，基于研究结果，我们为完善中国碳排放交易体系和加速能源转型提供了相应的政策启示。

articles.title_en: Impact of climate policy uncertainty on return spillover among green assets and portfolio implications
articles.title_cn: 气候政策不确定性对绿色资产间收益溢出效应的影响及投资组合启示
articles.abstract_en: Green assets play a crucial role in addressing climate change, encompassing sustainable development, public health improvement, and climate risk mitigation. This study investigates the return spillover among green assets and examines the impact of climate policy uncertainty (CPU) on their interrelationship, using a quantile connectedness approach. Empirical results show that return connectedness among green assets is particularly strong during extreme events, with a surge in total connectedness attributed to increased spillover between the green bond market and other green assets. Additionally, CPU reduces the connectedness among green assets, favouring the idiosyncratic channel over investors' uncertainty channel. Based on these findings, we propose a CPU-driven portfolio rebalancing strategy for green investors to enhance diversification across green stock, green bond, and renewable energy markets. Simulation results demonstrate that the CPU-based portfolios outperform the buy-and-hold portfolio in terms of average monthly returns, standard deviation, and risk-adjusted returns. The research highlights the need for policymakers to acknowledge and address climate policy uncertainty, as it influences the interconnectedness of green assets, offering an opportunity to refine policy frameworks to better support stable and resilient investment environments conducive to sustainable development goals.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色资产在应对气候变化中发挥着关键作用，涵盖可持续发展、公共健康改善和气候风险缓解。本研究采用分位数连通性方法，考察绿色资产间的收益溢出效应，并探讨气候政策不确定性（CPU）对其相互关系的影响。实证结果表明，绿色资产间的收益连通性在极端事件期间尤为强劲，总连通性的激增归因于绿色债券市场与其他绿色资产之间溢出效应的增强。此外，CPU降低了绿色资产间的连通性，偏好于特质渠道而非投资者不确定性渠道。基于这些发现，我们为绿色投资者提出了一种由CPU驱动的投资组合再平衡策略，以增强绿色股票、绿色债券和可再生能源市场之间的多元化。模拟结果表明，基于CPU的投资组合在平均月度收益、标准差和风险调整收益方面均优于买入并持有策略。研究强调，政策制定者需要认识并应对气候政策不确定性，因为它影响绿色资产的相互关联性，为完善政策框架以更好地支持稳定且有韧性的投资环境、促进可持续发展目标提供了机会。

articles.title_en: A Chinese clout on energy exports some countries cannot shake off
articles.title_cn: 中国对能源出口的影响力：一些国家难以摆脱
articles.abstract_en: The Chinese-led Belt and Road Initiative has created unprecedented economic opportunities for developing and underdeveloped countries to became more active in international trade, including in energy exports. The dynamics overlap with a worrying trend in democratic governance and accountability in these same countries, raising policy challenges for their long-term development prospects. By adopting a system approach within a panel dataset, we estimate this policy trade-off and reveal the heterogeneity dimension of these effects for a large set of countries and across a number of economic sectors linked to energy exports. Finally, we discuss some policy implications of our results.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国主导的“一带一路”倡议为发展中国家和不发达国家创造了前所未有的经济机会，使其更积极地参与国际贸易，包括能源出口。这些动态与这些国家在民主治理和问责制方面令人担忧的趋势重叠，对其长期发展前景构成了政策挑战。通过在面板数据集中采用系统方法，我们估计了这种政策权衡，并揭示了这些效应对大量国家和与能源出口相关的多个经济部门的异质性维度。最后，我们讨论了我们的结果的一些政策含义。

articles.title_en: The carbon premium: Correlation or causality? Evidence from S&P 500 companies
articles.title_cn: 碳溢价：相关性还是因果性？来自标普500公司的证据
articles.abstract_en: In the context of whether investors are aware of carbon-related risks, it is often hypothesized that there may be a carbon premium in the value of stocks of firms, conferring an abnormal excess value to firms’ shares as a form of compensation to investors for their transition risk exposure through the ownership of carbon intensive stocks. However, there is little consensus in the literature regarding the existence of such a premium. Moreover few studies have examined whether the correlation that is often observed is actually causal. The pertinent question is whether more polluting firms give higher returns or do firms with high returns have less incentive to decarbonize? In this study, we investigate whether firms’ emissions is causally linked to the presence of a carbon premium in a panel of 141 firms listed in the S&P 500 index using fixed-effects analysis, with propensity score weighting to control for selection bias in which firms increase their emissions. We find that there is a statistically significant positive carbon premium associated with Scope 1 emissions, while there is no significant premium associated with Scope 2 emissions, implying that risks associated with direct emissions by the firm are priced, while bought emissions are not.
articles.abstract_cn: 在投资者是否意识到碳相关风险的背景下，通常假设公司股票价值中可能存在碳溢价，赋予公司股票异常超额价值，作为对投资者通过持有碳密集型股票而承担转型风险暴露的补偿。然而，关于这种溢价的存在，文献中几乎没有共识。此外，很少有研究考察经常观察到的相关性是否实际上是因果关系。相关的问题是，污染更严重的公司是否带来更高的回报，还是高回报的公司减少脱碳的激励更少？在本研究中，我们使用固定效应分析，并采用倾向得分加权来控制公司增加排放的选择偏差，考察在标普500指数中的141家公司面板中，公司排放是否与碳溢价的存在存在因果关系。我们发现，与范围1排放相关的碳溢价在统计上显著为正，而与范围2排放相关的溢价不显著，这意味着与公司直接排放相关的风险被定价，而购买排放则未被定价。

articles.title_en: Government environmental attention, credit supply and firms' green investment
articles.title_cn: 政府环境关注、信贷供给与企业绿色投资
articles.abstract_en: This study employs textual analysis to construct a dataset reflecting the level of environmental attention by local governments and utilizes data from Chinese A-share listed companies between 2003 and 2020 as a sample to investigate the impact of local government's environmental attention on firms' green investment. The findings demonstrate that local government's environmental attention positively influences companies' green investment. Mechanism analyses reveal that local government's environmental attention primarily stimulates enterprise green investment by expanding the scale of green credit supply and reinforcing local environmental regulations. The effect of local government's environmental attention is more pronounced for state-owned enterprises, heavily polluting firms, large-scale firms, and firms with higher cash reserves and low financing constraint. Moreover, the influence is particularly significant in eastern China as well as regions characterized by lower ecological levels and stronger enforcement of environmental regulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究采用文本分析构建反映地方政府环境关注水平的数据库，并以2003年至2020年间中国A股上市公司数据为样本，考察地方政府环境关注对企业绿色投资的影响。研究结果表明，地方政府环境关注对企业绿色投资具有正向影响。机制分析显示，地方政府环境关注主要通过扩大绿色信贷供给规模和加强地方环境规制来刺激企业绿色投资。地方政府环境关注的作用在国有企业、重污染企业、大规模企业以及现金储备较高和融资约束较低的企业中更为显著。此外，该影响在华东地区以及生态水平较低和环境规制执行力度较强的地区尤为突出。

articles.title_en: Is artificial intelligence a curse or a blessing for enterprise energy intensity? Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 人工智能是企业能源强度的诅咒还是福音？来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) has experienced significant momentum worldwide in recent years. However, its rapid growth has raised concerns about energy shortages due to its high energy consumption, despite its potential to conserve energy in various ways. This study seeks to investigate the impact of AI on enterprise energy intensity (EI) by analyzing data from Chinese manufacturing listed enterprises during the period of 2011–2019. The findings reveal that the widespread adoption of AI can significantly reduce enterprise EI. Specifically, incorporating an additional unit of industrial robots per hundred workers leads to an approximate 2.5% reduction in enterprise EI. These conclusions remain robust after performing various tests. Moreover, the reduction effect of AI on enterprise EI is more pronounced in enterprises with high energy-dependence, non-labor-intensive enterprises, and state-owned enterprises (SOEs). Mechanism analysis further indicates that AI achieves enterprise EI reduction by facilitating technological innovation and digital transformation. Additionally, the study highlights the influence of business cycles, industrial concentration, and environmental regulations on the impact of AI on reducing enterprise EI. These findings not only alleviate excessive concerns regarding AI's energy consumption but also emphasize the necessity for governments to formulate corresponding policies aimed at reducing enterprise EI.
articles.abstract_cn: 近年来，人工智能（AI）在全球范围内经历了显著的发展势头。然而，其快速增长引发了对其高能耗可能导致能源短缺的担忧，尽管它在多方面具有节能潜力。本研究旨在通过分析2011-2019年间中国制造业上市企业的数据，探讨人工智能对企业能源强度（EI）的影响。研究结果表明，人工智能的广泛采用可以显著降低企业能源强度。具体而言，每百名工人每增加一个单位的工业机器人，企业能源强度大约降低2.5%。这些结论在经过各种测试后依然稳健。此外，人工智能对企业能源强度的降低效应在能源依赖度高、非劳动密集型以及国有企业（SOEs）中更为显著。机制分析进一步表明，人工智能通过促进技术创新和数字化转型来实现企业能源强度的降低。此外，研究还强调了商业周期、产业集中度和环境法规对人工智能降低企业能源强度影响的作用。这些发现不仅缓解了对人工智能能源消耗的过度担忧，也强调了政府制定相应政策以降低企业能源强度的必要性。

articles.title_en: How does fiscal policy affect the green low-carbon transition from the perspective of the evolutionary game?
articles.title_cn: 财政政策如何影响绿色低碳转型——基于演化博弈的视角？
articles.abstract_en: The implementation of effective fiscal policy is an inevitable choice to help green low-carbon transition and strengthen the construction of ecological civilization. This paper constructs a dynamic model of the tripartite evolutionary game among the central government, the local government and the high pollution and high carbon emission (Double-high) enterprises. Accordingly, we examine the impact of the central government's regulatory mechanism and local government's implementation intensity on green and low-carbon transition. Taking Comprehensive Demonstration Cities of Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction Fiscal Policies as the entry point of the study, a staggered differences-in-differences model is used for empirical evaluation, which reveals the effect of fiscal policy on green and low-carbon transition. The theoretical modeling shows that the strategies of Double-high enterprises are affected by the interaction between the central government and local governments, and there is diversity in the strategy stability and equilibrium state of each subject. Under the premise that the central government pays attention to the motives of enterprises and local governments, the fiscal subsidies, tax incentives and penalties of local governments, as well as the supervision, reward and punishment mechanisms and transfer payments of the central government, directly shape the impact of fiscal policy on green and low-carbon transition. The empirical results show that effective fiscal policy can promote green low-carbon transition, in which fiscal decentralization has a moderating role. Finally, the paper emphasizes the importance of the leading role of the central government and the implementation capacity of local governments, as well as the key role of internal changes within firms in addressing the relationship between emissions reduction and development.
articles.abstract_cn: 实施有效的财政政策是助力绿色低碳转型、加强生态文明建设的必然选择。本文构建了中央政府、地方政府与高污染高排放（“双高”）企业三方演化博弈的动态模型。据此，我们考察了中央政府的监管机制和地方政府的执行力度对绿色低碳转型的影响。以节能减排财政政策综合示范城市作为研究的切入点，采用交错双重差分模型进行实证评估，揭示了财政政策对绿色低碳转型的作用。理论建模表明，“双高”企业的策略受到中央政府与地方政府互动的影响，各主体的策略稳定性与均衡状态存在多样性。在中央政府关注企业和地方政府动机的前提下，地方政府的财政补贴、税收优惠和惩罚，以及中央政府的监督、奖惩机制和转移支付，直接塑造了财政政策对绿色低碳转型的影响。实证结果表明，有效的财政政策能够促进绿色低碳转型，其中财政分权具有调节作用。最后，本文强调了中央政府的主导作用和地方政府的执行能力的重要性，以及企业内部变革在应对减排与发展关系中的关键作用。

articles.title_en: Dynamic bargaining game DEA carbon emissions abatement allocation and the Nash equilibrium
articles.title_cn: 动态讨价还价博弈DEA碳排放减排分配与纳什均衡
articles.abstract_en: Allocating carbon emissions abatement (CEA) is crucial for reducing carbon footprint of organizations (or decision-making units, DMUs) and mitigating global warming. However, discrepancies often arise among DMUs regarding CEA allocation. This study introduces a dynamic bargaining game approach to address the issue under the nonparametric production frontier analysis framework. Our approach employs an iterative process, allowing each DMU to propose its individual preferred CEA allocation proposal in each iteration. Subsequently, dynamic negotiations among the DMUs occur, leading to the eventual consensus on the CEA allocation result. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that, at the end of the dynamic bargaining game, all DMUs will converge on the same CEA allocation result, termed as the consensus CEA allocation result. This agreement is reached despite each DMU customizing its individual CEA allocation proposal to suit its own interests. Moreover, we prove that this consensus CEA allocation result represents a Nash equilibrium solution, thereby ensuring its stability and acceptance among all DMUs. Finally, we provide a simple numerical example and a case study of CEA allocation across 27 European Union countries to illustrate the usefulness of our approach and compare it with prior CEA allocation approaches.
articles.abstract_cn: 分配碳排放减排（CEA）对于减少组织（或决策单元，DMU）的碳足迹和缓解全球变暖至关重要。然而，各DMU之间在CEA分配上常常出现分歧。本研究引入了一种动态讨价还价博弈方法，以在非参数生产前沿分析框架下解决该问题。我们的方法采用迭代过程，允许每个DMU在每次迭代中提出其个人偏好的CEA分配方案。随后，各DMU之间进行动态谈判，最终就CEA分配结果达成共识。我们的理论分析表明，在动态讨价还价博弈结束时，所有DMU将收敛于相同的CEA分配结果，称为共识CEA分配结果。尽管每个DMU根据自身利益定制其个人CEA分配方案，但仍能达成这一协议。此外，我们证明了这一共识CEA分配结果代表纳什均衡解，从而确保其稳定性和所有DMU的接受度。最后，我们提供了一个简单的数值示例和跨27个欧盟国家的CEA分配案例研究，以说明我们方法的实用性，并将其与先前的CEA分配方法进行比较。

articles.title_en: Resource booms and the energy transition: What can we learn from Dutch economists' response to the discovery of natural gas reserves (1959–1977)?
articles.title_cn: 资源繁荣与能源转型：我们能从荷兰经济学家对天然气储量发现的回应中学到什么（1959-1977）？
articles.abstract_en: Geopolitical instability and climate change are about to bring about large-scale energy reconfigurations. Recent discoveries of fossil fuel potential echo important historical episodes, starting with the finding of natural gas reserves in the Netherlands in 1959, which gave birth to the notion of Dutch Disease, in reference to the macroeconomic structural readjustments that followed the resource boom. Recently, the economic literature on whether such a boom might be a blessing or a curse for a country has been growing. What has not received attention so far is the attitude of Dutch economists in the 1960s and 1970s and the lessons to be drawn from them in today's economic research. This article explores how they understood the gas boom, how they anticipated its effects, and the role they played in shaping Dutch energy policies. We show that the 1960s were a parenthesis, and that energy optimism has historically been more an exception than a rule. In situ economists correctly anticipated some but not all of the transmission channels of the resource boom. These results are insightful for the 21st century, as they not only allow for historicizing the concept of the resource curse but also provide lessons for macroeconomic policies in the context of the energy transition, especially in countries endowed with fossil fuels and mineral resources.
articles.abstract_cn: 地缘政治不稳定和气候变化即将带来大规模的能源重构。近期对化石燃料潜力的发现呼应了重要的历史事件，始于1959年荷兰天然气储量的发现，这一发现催生了“荷兰病”的概念，指的是资源繁荣后随之而来的宏观经济结构性调整。近年来，关于这种繁荣对一个国家是福是祸的经济学文献不断增长。迄今为止，尚未受到关注的是荷兰经济学家在1960年代和1970年代的态度，以及从中可以汲取的教训对当今经济研究的启示。本文探讨了他们如何理解天然气繁荣，如何预期其影响，以及他们在塑造荷兰能源政策中所扮演的角色。我们表明，1960年代是一个插曲，能源乐观主义在历史上更多是例外而非常态。当地经济学家正确预见了资源繁荣的某些但非全部的传导渠道。这些结果对21世纪具有洞察力，因为它们不仅有助于将资源诅咒概念历史化，还为能源转型背景下的宏观经济政策提供了教训，尤其是在拥有化石燃料和矿产资源的国家。

articles.title_en: The role of AI capabilities in environmental management: Evidence from USA firms
articles.title_cn: 人工智能能力在环境管理中的作用：来自美国企业的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities in influencing firms' greenwashing behaviors. We find a robust negative association between firms' AI capabilities and unrepresentative environmental disclosure. An instrumental variable approach is employed to establish causality. The effects are more pronounced for firms (1) with a greater exposure to regulatory climate risk, (2) managed by Republican-leaning managers, (3) with stronger governance structures, (4) possessing greater product market pricing power, (5) operating in multiple regions, and (6) with CEOs with higher pay-for-performance sensitivity. We further demonstrate that AI capabilities aid firms in transitioning to green operations through engaging in green and clean innovation. Finally, we find that AI capabilities correlate with lower greenhouse gas emissions. Overall, our findings shed light on the real impact of AI-related technologies in the energy industry.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了人工智能（AI）能力在影响企业漂绿行为中的作用。我们发现企业AI能力与非代表性环境披露之间存在稳健的负相关关系。采用工具变量方法来建立因果关系。对于（1）面临更大监管气候风险敞口、（2）由共和党倾向管理者管理、（3）具有更强治理结构、（4）拥有更大产品市场定价权、（5）在多个地区运营以及（6）CEO具有更高薪酬绩效敏感性的企业，这种效应更为显著。我们进一步证明，AI能力通过参与绿色和清洁创新帮助企业向绿色运营转型。最后，我们发现AI能力与较低的温室气体排放相关。总体而言，我们的研究结果揭示了AI相关技术在能源行业中的实际影响。
